answer: An identity's answers must stay mutually consistent across epochs: a claim contradicted by its own later submission voids both, and the pair is flagged at replay. The yarrow history is re-read at each close, thread lists the contradictions, and tide records the voided pairs. A farm that generates text cheaply cannot hold a coherent position over 15 epochs, which means its own output eventually convicts it. A farm of 91 pays that 205 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
